ValidationRule.description: IMC set up date and IMC Login sent to customer are required prior to the case being closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $RecordType.Name == 'NCSP: DMS' && ISPICKVAL(Status,'Closed') && ( isblank(IMC_Setup_Date__c) || isblank( IMC_Login_sent_to_customer__c )) && ISPICKVAL( IMC_Connect__c , 'Yes')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: IMC Setup Date and IMC Login sent to customer are required if IMConnect Required = 'Yes'
